english.meaning: an ingredient; material or stuff to work with
english.note: 有料 means 'to have the stuff', that is, to be capable.

exampleSentences.english: Then you have to buy the hot-and-sour soup ingredients there first.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉嗰度有料買酸辣湯啲嘢先得𠿪。

exampleSentences.english: So, Grandma, first we need to see if you’ve got what it takes.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉阿婆我哋而家首先就要證實究竟你有冇料到。
